title: Dealing with Offenders who Have Been Repeatedly Issued Notices for Severe Breaches of Fire Safety Regulations
what_it_is: Dealing with Offenders who Have Been Repeatedly Issued Notices for Severe Breaches of Fire Safety Regulations

sections.label: SCDF fire safety enforcement policy
sections.summary: SCDF issues abatement notices or composition fines for minor non-compliance, higher fines for repeats, and may prosecute serious or repeated breaches.

sentences.speaker: Ms Hazel Poa
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Home Affairs what is the Singapore Civil Defence Force's policy for dealing with offenders who have been repeatedly issued notices of offence for severe breaches of fire safety regulations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: It issues abatement notices or impose composition fines for minor cases of non-compliance.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Higher fines are imposed for repeated instances, and prosecution in court may follow if the errant party fails to rectify the non-compliance.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: For more serious breaches and repeated offences of serious breaches, SCDF will consider prosecution.

sections.label: SCDF inspections and enforcement approach
sections.summary: SCDF works with owners, takes serious breaches to task, continues inspections, and takes an escalatory approach because fires may cause damage and loss of life.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: In cases like the one that the Member referred to, and also as shared by my colleague Dr Amy Khor, whereby the SCDF went to inspect 10 times during the said period.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: So, we work with with the owners, and like what I shared in my answer, if there are serious breaches, we will take them to task.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: We will look at the setting, the context and at the same time, we will not hesitate, not only in taking action but will continue to do inspections, making sure that they are safe.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: I think at the end of the day, every case is unique and we not only take an escalatory approach, we are very serious about this, because fires not only cause damages, lives may be lost.

sections.label: Fire safety and agency levers
sections.summary: Other agencies can use their levers, and fire safety is not compromised so businesses continue while lives are not at risk.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: While we can use our levers, we also have our other agencies who can use their levers.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: At the end of the day, fire safety is critical.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: We do not compromise because what is key is that we want to make sure that while they are able to continue their business, lives are not at risk.
